item.title: Australians have expensive taste – more than half of all smartphone sales are above $1,000
item.summary: When it comes to smartphones Australians have expensive taste. Research from analyst firm Telsyte shows more than half of all smartphones sold in Australia in the first half of 2026 were priced above $1,000, with one in five priced at over $2,000.
